rules.universe: top N by trailing 60-observation median turnover; prior observations only; >=200 history and >=80% positive turnover/volume
rules.signal: close at latest observation < T divided by close 252 observations before that, using the latest observation 21 observations before the as-of row; no current month
rules.selection: top percentage by momentum; equal weight
rules.rebalance: actual month-end session, shifted -3/0/+3 sessions only in robustness; execute next available open
rules.costs: round-trip scenarios translated to half per side slippage; canonical NSE multipliers retained
rules.accounting: integer shares, explicit cash, ex-post total-return marking for measurement only

anti_leakage.future_corporate_actions_do_not_enter_PI: PASS by separated PIT/ex-post layers and regression suite

single_stock.rules: first observed date target, next available open, terminal adjusted close, integer shares, configured 10 bps/side plus canonical charges
